brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stacked full bases at 0,0,0 and 0,0,1 forming two storeys (level 0 & 1), ~160mm tall, plus half-n extensions providing drawer fronts. capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied.
drawer:0#0,1#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,1#cut at level 1, both installed and opened for visibility, with pliers prop demonstrating storage use.

finish.summary: Built compact two-storey tower (full hex column with half-n drawer faces each level) with two operable drawers. Dressed with workshop prop visible when drawers open. Verified check_build clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
